verdict.rationale: Daryanani Law Group is a boutique immigration law firm offering attorney-led visa and green card services, not a software platform. Issuing scoped, least-privilege API credentials for an agent is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows the firm offers any API, and the probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
